arguments.code:
spotify_username='ch-burch@gmail.com'
spotify_password=None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name']=='spotify':
        spotify_password=a['password']
        break
print('have_password', spotify_password is not None)
res=apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username,password=spotify_password)
print(res)
spotify_token=res.get('access_token')
print('token_len', len(spotify_token) if spotify_token else None)

access_token = spotify_token
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_playlists=[]
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(res) if res else None)
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total_playlists',len(all_playlists))
print('sample_titles', [p['title'] for p in all_playlists[:5]])
# keep unique by id
ids=set()
unique=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    if p['playlist_id'] not in ids:
        ids.add(p['playlist_id'])
        unique.append(p)
print('unique_playlists',len(unique))
print('playlist_ids', [p['playlist_id'] for p in unique[:10]])

arguments.code:
access_token = spotify_token
playlist_ids = [p['playlist_id'] for p in unique]
results=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    total_minutes = total_seconds/60.0
    results.append({'playlist_id': pid,'title': pl.get('title'),'song_count': len(songs),'total_seconds': total_seconds,'total_minutes': total_minutes})
    print('playlist',pl.get('title'),'id',pid,'songs',len(songs),'total_seconds',total_seconds,'total_minutes',total_minutes)
# find shortest by total_seconds
shortest = min(results, key=lambda r: r['total_seconds'])
print('shortest',shortest)
print('rounded_minutes', int(round(shortest['total_minutes'])))
